title: NPR trims jobs in newsroom overhaul as it confronts era without public funding
summary: NPR is offering buyouts to journalists as it overhauls its newsroom, with the threat of layoffs to follow. Two recent gifts totaling $113 million are primarily dedicated to NPR's tech infrastructure.
contentText:
